description: Source code for a Chart of Accounts importer module in ERPNext, handling file uploads, validation, and tree building for account data.

classes.name: ChartofAccountsImporter
classes.description: A Document subclass for importing chart of accounts, with validation logic.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the importer file if present by calling get_coa for validation.

methods.name: validate_columns
methods.description: Checks if data is empty or has more columns than expected.

methods.name: validate_company
methods.description: Validates if the company is a parent or child and if accounts exist for the company.

methods.name: import_coa
methods.description: Main function to import chart of accounts from a file, build tree, create charts, and set defaults.

methods.name: get_file
methods.description: Retrieves the file document and extension from filename.

methods.name: generate_data_from_csv
methods.description: Reads CSV file and returns data as list or dict.

methods.name: generate_data_from_excel
methods.description: Reads Excel file and returns data as list or dict.

methods.name: get_coa
methods.description: Fetches account data and builds account tree for tree view or validation.

methods.name: build_forest
methods.description: Converts flat list of account data into nested tree structure.

methods.name: build_response_as_excel
methods.description: Generates and returns an Excel template file for download.

methods.name: download_template
methods.description: Provides download of account import templates in CSV or Excel.

methods.name: get_template
methods.description: Creates a template CSV/Excel writer with headers and sample data.

methods.name: get_sample_template
methods.description: Fills sample data into template writer.

methods.name: validate_accounts
methods.description: Validates account data for parent account presence and root types.

methods.name: validate_root
methods.description: Checks root accounts for required root types.

methods.name: validate_missing_roots
methods.description: Ensures all root types are present.

methods.name: get_root_types
methods.description: Returns valid root account types.

methods.name: get_report_type
methods.description: Returns report type based on root type.

methods.name: get_mandatory_group_accounts
methods.description: Returns mandatory group accounts.

methods.name: get_mandatory_account_types
methods.description: Returns list of mandatory account types with root types.

methods.name: unset_existing_data
methods.description: Removes existing account data for a company.

methods.name: set_default_accounts
methods.description: Sets default receivable and payable accounts for a company.
